dct_creator_sm: City of Peterborough Open Data Portal.
dct_description_sm:
This intersection layer was generated using existing intersection points then calculating the road names. The more major street will always be named first. No order preference is given in the case that both cross streets are the same class.

Due to this layer being generated automatically, there may be errors or inconsistencies.

Specifications
Data Author: City of Peterborough Geomatics & Mapping
Data Maintained With: Procedurally Generated
Update Frequency:  Monthly
